name: compressai-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is CompressAI, a PyTorch library for end-to-end learned data compression. This task
covers its compression core: the entropy models (entropy bottleneck and Gaussian conditional) and their
entropy coding, the composable latent codecs, the layers (GDN, masked convolutions, residual and attention
blocks), the bound and quantization operators, the colour and YUV transforms, the rate-distortion losses, the
base compression model classes with the factorized-prior, hyperprior and context-model architectures, and the
module registry.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the Python modules compressai/__init__.py, everything under compressai/entropy_models/, compressai/latent_codecs/, compressai/ops/ and compressai/registry/, the modules compressai/layers/__init__.py, compressai/layers/basic.py, compressai/layers/gdn.py, compressai/layers/layers.py and everything under compressai/layers/attn/ and compressai/layers/wave/, the modules compressai/transforms/__init__.py, compressai/transforms/functional.py and compressai/transforms/transforms.py, the modules compressai/losses/__init__.py, compressai/losses/rate_distortion.py, compressai/losses/utils.py and compressai/losses/cca.py, and the modules compressai/models/__init__.py, compressai/models/base.py, compressai/models/utils.py, compressai/models/google.py, compressai/models/priors.py, compressai/models/waseda.py and compressai/models/sensetime.py, t
